system.description: With this potent Charm, an Emanation can unleash powerful agents into the Wyld or Creation. The Emanation must already have Reflected Glory and Father's Commanding Voice active to activate this Charm, paying 10 motes and two Willpower for an offspring in the Wyld (plus two gossamer if the offspring is in Creation). While Extravagant Birthday Reward is active, the Emanation's child can draw upon the Emanation's spiritual and metaphysical resources, allowing her to spend the Emanation's Essence, Willpower, gossamer and even Virtue channels in place of her own.
